name: Santiago Gonzalez — additional son Manuel (b. 1915)
researcher_question: Did Santiago Gonzalez and his wife Petra Tumbaco of Guayaquil, Ecuador have a son named Manuel de Jesus, born 1915, in addition to their two known daughters (b. 1921 and 1934)?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 15, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved: false match. The hint is the Santiago-Gonzalez father-persona of a single Ecuadorian cemetery record for Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco whose mother is 'Petita Tumbaco' (a distinct name from the tree wife 'Petra'); no independent record corroborates the parentage, so the agent must not add Manuel as a son.
